title: The Play Store update path is never tested: download, ready sheet and restart
what: Every device test of the update screen uses a made-up sideloaded copy. The Play words ('It downloads while you keep using the app'), the busy button, the downloading line, the 'The new version is ready to install' sheet and 'Restart now' are never put on screen, and no test checks that workouts survive the restart.
expected: A test that walks a Play member from 'Update now' through the download, the ready sheet and the restart, and checks saved workouts afterwards.
fix_line: Add a Play stand-in to the device test and walk the download, ready sheet and restart

title: No test taps 'Update now' or the line's 'Update'
what: The device test checks the update buttons are there but never taps them, so nothing checks a download starts, that a second tap starts no second download, or that the line's Update does anything.
expected: A test that taps 'Update now' and the line's 'Update' and checks the download starts once.
fix_line: Tap both update buttons in the device test and check one download starts

title: The watch install card is never shown on screen in any test
what: Only the rules behind the card are tested. No test shows 'MettleUp works on your watch too', taps 'Install on watch' or 'Not now', or reads 'Opening on your watch…', the not-connected line or 'Got it'. A fast double tap is never tried.
expected: A device test with a made-up watch that shows the card after a first own workout and walks each answer.
fix_line: Add a made-up watch to a device test and walk the install card

title: The Balance check card is never shown on screen; its save failure and 'Go back' flow are untested
what: The card is only read as source text. No test shows it with a real muscle, taps 'Not now', 'Keep it' or 'Go back', checks the 'Put ... back?' question, or the red 'Could not save. Please try again.' line.
expected: A device or render test that shows the card for a member with 4 weeks of uneven workouts and walks each button, including a failed save.
fix_line: Add a device step that shows the Balance check card and taps its buttons

title: The body map's empty words and its 30 and 90 day chips are never tested
what: The device test only opens the 7 day map and one muscle. No test checks 'Nothing trained in the last 7 days', taps the 30 or 90 day chip, or checks the map reads again after a new workout.
expected: A test for an empty week and for each range chip, checking the words and the sheet follow the range.
fix_line: Add the empty week and the range chips to the body map device step

title: The Strength score chart is never shown in any test
what: Only the score sum and the empty-state choice are tested. No test shows 'Strength score', the '<n>/100' figure, the line, a tapped point's date, the 'Add body weight' button opening the entry, or the chart appearing after body weight is added.
expected: A device test that opens the Strength score with and without body weight and taps a point.
fix_line: Add the Strength score card to a device test, empty and filled

title: A line chart's tap box and a range change on a picked bar are never tested
what: The chart test taps bar charts only. Nothing checks the Strength score line's box with its number and date, that the box stays inside the chart, or that changing the range clears a picked bar.
expected: A test that taps a line chart point near the edge and changes the range with a bar picked.
fix_line: Add a line chart tap and a range change to the chart device test

title: Exercise History paging, the open workout row and deleted workouts are never tested
what: The device test only checks the History tab shows workouts and never 'Showing the last'. No test checks newest first, 'Show 5 more · 5 left', the button going away at the end, the open workout first, or that a deleted workout leaves the list.
expected: A test with more than 5 workouts of one exercise that pages through, opens a row, and deletes one.
fix_line: Add paging, open and delete checks to the History tab device step

title: The Reports card row words and last year's review are never checked on screen
what: Only the choice of rows is tested. No test checks the '<n> workouts' line (or '1 workout' singular), that the opened report is the right month, or opens last year's review in January.
expected: A test that reads the report row line and opens each row, including in January.
fix_line: Add the row line and a January run to the reports device step

title: 'See earlier updates' and the What's new buttons are never tapped in a test
what: The device test shows the 'New in this version' card and taps 'Got it' only. No test opens 'See earlier updates', checks 'Hide earlier updates', taps a try-it button, or opens a settings page from What's new.
expected: A test that opens the earlier updates and taps one try-it button from the card and from Settings.
fix_line: Tap 'See earlier updates' and one try-it button in the What's new device test

title: No test checks these phone checks and cards send no workout or health data
what: The update check, the two watch checks, the What's new card, the Balance check, the body map, the reports and the charts are never tested for what they send or show beyond the member's own figures.
expected: A test per check that records what leaves the phone and finds only version words.
fix_line: Add a test that records each check's outgoing request and asserts no workout data

title: No test double-taps 'Update on watch'
what: The watch pop-up's device test taps 'Update on watch' once each time. Nothing checks that a fast double tap opens the watch's Play Store only once, nor that the 'New on your watch' lines show on screen.
expected: A double tap step that checks a single open, and a check of the 'New on your watch' lines.
fix_line: Add a double tap and the watch lines to the watch update device test
